model_interpretation.claim: Parallelizing the independent per-option loop should improve throughput on large inputs while preserving each option's baseline arithmetic and operation order. Limiting the team to the positive run thread budget and input count avoids excess workers; keeping small counts out of a multi-thread team should reduce launch overhead. These effects remain to be measured.
